description: This file defines the 'Task' model class within the OpenCart admin setting module. It manages CRUD operations and logging functionalities for scheduled tasks stored in the database.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents scheduled tasks in the system, providing methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and logging related to tasks.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates a new task record in the database, replacing any existing task with the same code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and optional response of a task identified by task_id.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task record identified by task_id.

methods.name: deleteTaskByCode
methods.description: Removes tasks from the database based on their unique code.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Truncates the task table, removing all task records.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific task by its ID.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Fetches a list of tasks with optional filtering by code and status, and supports pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTasks
methods.description: Returns the total count of tasks matching optional filters.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Inserts a log entry associated with a specific task code.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of task log entries with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogs
methods.description: Returns the total number of log entries.
